verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs describe a complete end-to-end flow — checkout session creation via ACP/UCP, shared payment token (SPT) issuance as a delegated payment credential with scoped usage limits, and order confirmation surfaced as checkout.session.completed events tagged by agent — with the Link CLI wallet also providing one-time-use credentials for agent purchases. However, the core ACS/OCA embedded-checkout and custom seller integration paths are explicitly gated as 'private preview', US/Canada/Europe-only, waitlist-gated, and agent-side commentary flags sparse documentation on end-to-end object semantics. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a real completed purchase outside private preview, broader geographic/GA availability, and clearer public documentation of full object-level flow (vs. community complaints of sparse docs).
